## MetForge Skills v2026.7.10

This release makes the skill collection easier to discover and use:

- adds a Quick Start with copy-ready prompts for data acquisition, data inspection, atmospheric visualization, figure audit, dynamical-core diagnosis, and combined analysis
- adds complete Simplified Chinese documentation in `README_ZH.md`
- links the English and Chinese documentation from the repository header
- documents explicit `$metforge-data`, `$metforge-figure`, and `$metforge-analysis` invocation examples
- retains independent installation and validation for all three Codex skills
